title: Credo (Palestrina, Missa Quem dicunt homines)
desc: Giovanni Pierluigi da Palestrina, Missa Quem dicunt homines, Credo. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Mass_0035_3); edited by Peter Ackermann, Richard Freedman, Vincent Besson. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
